# GB News

> GB News is a British news platform delivering breaking news, political analysis, and opinion content across UK, US, and world news with interactive viewer engagement features.

GB News operates as a comprehensive news portal featuring coverage of politics, royal news, and current events, complemented by opinion programming from prominent broadcasters and interactive polling through the You Decide platform. The site serves as both a news aggregation hub and membership-based community platform.

## Key Topics

- breaking news
- UK politics
- GB News
- opinion content
- royal news
- news portal

## News Hub

- [Home](https://www.gbnews.com): GB News homepage with latest breaking news, opinion and analysis
- [News](https://www.gbnews.com/news): Latest breaking news from GB News covering UK politics and updates
- [UK News](https://www.gbnews.com/news/uk): UK news hub with latest breaking news, politics and royal coverage
- [US News](https://www.gbnews.com/news/us): US news section with latest breaking American news and analysis
- [World News](https://www.gbnews.com/news/world): World news hub covering international breaking news and events

## Viewer Engagement

- [You Decide](https://www.gbnews.com/youdecide): You Decide polling platform for viewer engagement and interactive content
